notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing all lands you control, adding one mana of any type the land can produce.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper, adding {B}.
World Shaper dies, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning World Shaper onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
